pages.text: $(item)Graphene$() is a single sheet of carbon atoms in hexagons. Roll it and you have $(item)Carbon Nanotubes$(); fold sixty atoms into a ball and you have a $(item)Buckyball$() - hollow, with room for one guest atom inside.

Supramolecular chemistry builds with these: $(item)Metal-Organic Frameworks$() (more inner surface per gram than a football pitch), $(item)Noble Gas Clathrates$() (xenon caged in ice) and $(item)Self-Healing Polymers$().
Carbon one atom thick. Stronger than steel, conducts better than copper.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chemical Reactor$().
Graphene rolled into tubes, the tubes twisted into rope.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chemical Reactor$().
Sixty carbon atoms arranged like a football - with room inside for one more atom.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chemical Reactor$().
Metal nodes, organic struts: a sponge with more inner surface than a football pitch per gram.$(br2)Made in $(item)Framework Assembler$().
Xenon caged in ice. The noble gases are not as aloof as the textbooks said.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chemical Reactor$().
Cut it and the chains find each other again.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chemical Reactor$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Graphene Sheet$(): Buckyball Cage, Carbon Nanotube Bundle, Metal-Organic Framework$(li)$(item)Carbon Nanotube Bundle$(): Metal-Organic Framework, Self-Healing Polymer$(li)$(item)Buckyball Cage$(): Minimal Synthetic Cell, Noble Gas Clathrate, Positronium Hydride$(li)$(item)Metal-Organic Framework$(): Framework Assembler, Morphogenic Serum, Room-Temperature Superconductor$(li)$(item)Noble Gas Clathrate$(): Muonic Catalyst, Primordial Soup
